definition: serial unactuated N hinges on one horizontally actuated cart; N is not the MPC horizon
notes: Angles alternate amplitude and minus half-amplitude, expressed in absolute world angle then converted to relative hinges.
No parameter or tolerance tuning after this manifest is run.
Same 1 m full length and 0.1 kg per pole: total height/mass grow with N.
DARE numeric rejection is not a theorem of physical impossibility.
Fixed local linear controller and stationary KF, not generalized EKF/NMPC or swing-up.
